title: Cross-contract proof obligations
description: Machine-readable registry of the system-level (cross-contract) proof obligations specified in docs/formal-verification-cross-contract.md. Each obligation names the executable code path it constrains (source_file / source_symbols) and the integration test that discharges it (test_file / verified_by). scripts/check-proof-obligations.py and contracts/iln_governance/src/tests_proof_obligations.rs validate this registry against the tree so an obligation cannot silently lose its evidence or drift away from the code it bounds.

obligations.title: Funding notifies distribution
obligations.property: After set_distribution_contract and a successful fund_invoice, iln_distribution.get_accrual(lp) is strictly greater than its pre-fund value.

obligations.title: Settlement notifies distribution
obligations.property: After a successful on-time mark_paid, freelancer (and payer, when rates are non-zero) distribution accruals are strictly greater than their pre-settlement values.

obligations.title: Insurance claim payout is bounded by pool and enrollment
obligations.property: For a defaulted, insurance-wired invoice whose LP is enrolled with a solvent pool, claim_default succeeds and insurance_pool.get_pool_balance() afterwards equals the pre-claim balance minus the paid compensation (or is unchanged when compensation is zero / not enrolled); the pool balance never goes negative.

obligations.title: Escrow plus insurance reserves do not exceed tracked inflows
obligations.property: After any sequence of fund / premium-deposit / settle / claim operations, the ILN escrow balance plus the insurance pool balance plus the tracked user balances equals the total minted payment-token supply: neither the pool nor escrow can manufacture tokens.

obligations.title: Cross-module default compensation is single-shot per invoice
obligations.property: After a successful claim_default that pulled insurance compensation for invoice_id, a second claim_default for the same id fails without reducing the pool again, and the pool rejects a second claim(invoice_id) with already-claimed semantics.
